title: Deleting a custom role that has users is blocked
custom_preconds: 1. A custom role named 'Copy Test Role 2' has at least one user assigned.
custom_steps:
1. On the Roles list, look at the three-dot menu on 'Copy Test Role 2'.
  2. Try to delete it.
custom_expected: Deletion is blocked: the three-dot menu hides the Delete option when the role has users, and in the editor the Delete role button is disabled with the tooltip 'This role is assigned to N user(s). Reassign them to another role before deleting.'
viu_status: Blocked-UI (needs live Roles list); disabled tooltip build-verified
evidence: Disabled-Delete tooltip confirmed verbatim in build; no separate block modal.
